disposition.note: The inline DrawingML text box renders as a plain paragraph without its outline, so its line is 20.65pt instead of the box's 36pt. The GT box, its outline and its in-box 'Box text' have no counterpart, and every line below the box — including the yellow w:shd band, which this PR moved onto the paragraph that declares it — sits 13.02pt high. Same displacement, one root cause.
